### Leg‑Day Essentials: A Balanced, Progressive Routine

Below is a **complete, beginner‑to‑advanced leg workout** that targets all major lower‑body muscles (quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, and core stabilizers).  
Feel free to mix and match exercises, adjust volume, or swap in alternatives that fit your equipment or goals.

| Muscle Group | Exercise | Primary Movement | Sets × Reps | Key Tips |
|--------------|----------|------------------|-------------|----------|
| **Quads** | **Back Squat** | Hip & knee flexion | 4 × 6–10 | Keep chest up, knees tracking over toes, depth to parallel or below |
| | **Front Squat** | Hip & knee flexion (front load) | 3 × 8–12 | Hands on bar, elbows high, upright torso |
| | **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Single‑leg knee flexion | 3 × 8–12 each leg | Back foot elevated, front knee stays above ankle |
| | **Leg Press** | Hip & knee flexion | 3 × 10–15 | Feet shoulder‑width, avoid locking knees |
| | **Step‑Ups** | Hip extension | 3 × 10–12 each leg | Step height ~ knee level, drive through heel |
| | **Hack Squat** | Hip & knee flexion | 3 × 10–12 | Keep back flat, use full range |
| | **Goblet Squat** | Hip & knee flexion | 3 × 12–15 | Hold dumbbell at chest, keep elbows tight |
| | **Wall Sit** | Isometric quad contraction | 3 × 30–60 s | Knee at 90°, back flat against wall |
| | **Sissy Squat** | Quad isolation | 3 × 8–12 | Lean back, keep hips forward, use support if needed |
| | **Box Squat** | Controlled descent | 3 × 6–10 | Sit back onto box, pause, then explode up |
| | **Squat Jumps** | Plyometric quad activation | 3 × 8–10 | Land softly, knees slightly bent |
